WoW: Forever · Ranged DPS · Updated October 5, 2026 · Beta build 1.60.1.70124 · Null Ossuary

Levelling guide, 1 to 60. The beta is capped at level 30 as of the October 1 build, which Blizzard raised from 20 that day, so no level-60 Destruction build has been tested. No source has posted a level 30 build either — the cap only reached 30 on October 1 and none of the three has published one since — so the level 30 line below extends the published level 20 build using the full talent tree's point costs, not a build any guide has recommended.

What Destruction is for

Direct damage whose timing you control. BaneBaneTalentCastInstantReduces the casting time of your Shadow Bolt, Immolate, and Incinerate spells by 0.5 sec and your Soul Fire spell by 2 sec. 5/5 from level 14 takes half a second off Shadow BoltShadow BoltLevel 1 · Spell · ShadowCast1.7 sec castCost25 ManaRange30 yd rangeSends a shadowy bolt at the enemy, causing 13 Shadow damage., ImmolateImmolateLevel 1 · Spell · FireCast2 sec castCost25 ManaRange30 yd rangeDuration15 sec and IncinerateIncinerateLevel 40 · Spell · FireCast2.5 sec castCost205 ManaRange30 yd rangeDeals 97 Fire damage to your target and an additional 25% damage if the target is afflicted by Immolate. and two seconds off Soul FireSoul FireLevel 48 · Spell · FireCast6 sec castCost305 ManaRange30 yd rangeCooldown60 sec cooldownBurn the enemy's soul, causing 377 Fire damage., and ShadowburnShadowburnLevel 20 · Spell · ShadowCastInstantCost105 ManaRange30 yd rangeCooldown15 sec cooldownDuration8 secInstantly blasts the target for 66 Shadow damage. If a non-trivial target dies within 8 sec of being hit with Shadowburn, the caster gains a Soul Shard. at 20 is an instant that hands back a Soul Shard when a non-trivial target dies within 8 seconds of being hit by it.

Icy Veins is the only one of the three sources to score it, and it marks this spec down where it gives the other two full marks. Its ratings, out of 5:

SpecOverallLevellingDungeonMobility
Affliction5.05.04.03.0
Demonology5.05.04.03.0
Destruction3.53.54.02.0

The reasons, in the sources' own words: "You have less passive sustain than Affliction and less pet support than Demonology" · "Most of your damage requires you to stand still", and "taking damage while casting causes spell pushback" · "Searing PainSearing PainLevel 18 · Spell · FireCast1.5 sec castCost45 ManaRange30 yd rangeInflict searing pain on the enemy target, causing 23 Fire damage. Causes a high amount of threat. generates significant threat, however, and this build does not have the threat reduction from SuppressionSuppressionTalentCastInstantImproves your chance to hit by 5% and reduces all threat you generate by 20%." · "much of the specialization's new WoW Forever identity comes online at higher levels."

Wowhead makes the wand argument about the class generally, not Destruction specifically: "you'll use your wand more for damage because it deals more DPS than Shadow Bolt, and it's also mana-free." Destruction is the one spec that pushes back, because BaneBaneTalentCastInstantReduces the casting time of your Shadow Bolt, Immolate, and Incinerate spells by 0.5 sec and your Soul Fire spell by 2 sec. cuts Shadow BoltShadow BoltLevel 1 · Spell · ShadowCast1.7 sec castCost25 ManaRange30 yd rangeSends a shadowy bolt at the enemy, causing 13 Shadow damage.'s cast time, see Rotation below. Forever also cut its numbers hard. ConflagrateConflagrateLevel 25 · Spell · FireCastInstantCost100 ManaRange30 yd rangeCooldown10 sec cooldownIgnites a target that is already afflicted by your Immolate spell, dealing 95 Fire damage and consuming your Immolate effect. 84–106 where Classic gave 240–306; Soul FireSoul FireLevel 48 · Spell · FireCast6 sec castCost305 ManaRange30 yd rangeCooldown60 sec cooldownBurn the enemy's soul, causing 377 Fire damage. 334–420 against 623–783, while RuinRuinTalentCastInstantIncreases the critical strike damage bonus of your Destruction spells by 100%. went from a 1-rank 100% talent to a 5-rank one that only reaches 100% at 5/5.

In fairness, its own counter-argument: "Destruction does not need as much time to ramp as Affliction, making its direct damage useful when dungeon enemies are dying quickly." Its dungeon rating is 4.0, the same as the other two. On its own numbers the gap is in solo levelling, not dungeons.

Your talent points

Level 20: 0/0/11, and Icy Veins and Wowhead disagree on how much of the build is fixed.

Icy Veins' build is fully specified: BaneBaneTalentCastInstantReduces the casting time of your Shadow Bolt, Immolate, and Incinerate spells by 0.5 sec and your Soul Fire spell by 2 sec. 5, Destructive ReachDestructive ReachTalentCastInstantIncreases the range of your damaging spells by 20%. 2, CataclysmCataclysmTalentCastInstantReduces the Mana cost of your Destruction spells by 10%. 3, ShadowburnShadowburnLevel 20 · Spell · ShadowCastInstantCost105 ManaRange30 yd rangeCooldown15 sec cooldownDuration8 secInstantly blasts the target for 66 Shadow damage. If a non-trivial target dies within 8 sec of being hit with Shadowburn, the caster gains a Soul Shard. 1. "Improved Shadow BoltImproved Shadow BoltTalentCastInstant and AftermathAftermathTalentCastInstantIncreases the initial damage of your Immolate spell by 50% and your Conflagrate spell has a 100% chance to Daze the target, reducing the target's movement speed by 50% for 5 sec. are both strong alternatives, but this build prioritizes reliable leveling benefits that do not depend on Critical Strike, since we won't have much at this level."

ClassicWoW.gg does not publish a suggested build for any spec, by design.

The Legacy System adds points beyond these 11. Wowhead puts the cap at 7 legacy points from world exploration before level 25, worth 2 extra talent points. Its picks there are ShadowburnShadowburnLevel 20 · Spell · ShadowCastInstantCost105 ManaRange30 yd rangeCooldown15 sec cooldownDuration8 secInstantly blasts the target for 66 Shadow damage. If a non-trivial target dies within 8 sec of being hit with Shadowburn, the caster gains a Soul Shard., "instant burst on demand, at the cost of a soul shard. Good for finishing runners and for damage while moving", and RuinRuinTalentCastInstantIncreases the critical strike damage bonus of your Destruction spells by 100%., "increases the bonus damage on your destruction crits." Those points cannot be spent at 20 as printed. Blizzard's Known Issues list opening the Legacy System before level 25 as a bug — the “Y” hotkey works and throws LUA errors on tabs 1 and 3 — so read these as what to spend Legacy points on from 25, not as part of a level-20 build.

Rotation

Icy Veins and Wowhead order the opening DoTs differently, same as the other two specs. Icy Veins leads with Immolate, then Corruption, then Bane of Agony. Wowhead reverses it: "Bane of Agony first: it deals the least upfront damage, so it's the least threat and requires time to build up to full damage. Immolate last; its initial Hit generates direct threat, so it's the worst opener." Wowhead also wands less here than for the other two specs, calling wanding "an equally good option but not really Destruction-oriented" once BaneBaneTalentCastInstantReduces the casting time of your Shadow Bolt, Immolate, and Incinerate spells by 0.5 sec and your Soul Fire spell by 2 sec. is trained.

Your demon

Same unlocks — Imp 2, VoidwalkerVoidwalkerSpell · ShadowCastInstantCost32 ManaCooldown20 sec cooldownDuration180 secSummons 1 Voidwalker to aid the caster in battle for 180 sec. 10, Succubus 20, Felhunter 30. But Destruction has no pet talents at all.

You are a stand-still caster with no SuppressionSuppressionTalentCastInstantImproves your chance to hit by 5% and reduces all threat you generate by 20%. threat reduction, and beta reports point at the VoidwalkerVoidwalkerSpell · ShadowCastInstantCost32 ManaCooldown20 sec cooldownDuration180 secSummons 1 Voidwalker to aid the caster in battle for 180 sec.: it "generated an extremely high amount of threat" and is "the safest demon to use while leveling because it can hold enemies away from you while you hard cast." Its threat spell is TormentTormentTalentCastInstantCost20 ManaRangeMeleeCooldown5 sec cooldownTaunts the creature, increasing the chance that it will attack the Voidwalker., noticeably weaker until rank 2 trains at 20.

Stat priority

Spell Power, then Hit, Haste, critical strike, Spirit, Intellect, Stamina.

Haste is third here and last for the other two specs. The reason: "Destruction relies heavily on hard casts, so Haste benefits spells such as Shadow BoltShadow BoltLevel 1 · Spell · ShadowCast1.7 sec castCost25 ManaRange30 yd rangeSends a shadowy bolt at the enemy, causing 13 Shadow damage. and ImmolateImmolateLevel 1 · Spell · FireCast2 sec castCost25 ManaRange30 yd rangeDuration15 sec." Hit is called out harder too: "Destruction does not take SuppressionSuppressionTalentCastInstantImproves your chance to hit by 5% and reduces all threat you generate by 20%. at this level, so you receive no Hit from your talent build."

Sources

Compiled from the three major Forever guide sites and cross-checked against each other. Where Blizzard has published an official class deep dive, that post outranks all three and the page is written from it. Everything else — talent ranks, tooltip values, what exists in the tree at all — is settled against the client itself, read through foreverchanges.pro and wago.tools. Where the guides disagree with each other, this page says which said what.
